name: save-vcards
title: Save vCards
description: Save a contact from highlighted text, a screenshot or a business-card photo to Apple Contacts, read entirely on your Mac.
author: julianpaul

commands.name: save-vcard-from-selection
commands.title: Save vCard from Selection
commands.description: Reads the highlighted text and shows the contact it found. With nothing highlighted, it reads the clipboard.

commands.name: save-vcard-from-screenshot
commands.title: Save vCard from Screenshot
commands.description: Drag a box around a signature, business card or profile; the contact in it is read on your Mac.

commands.name: save-vcard
commands.title: Save vCard from Clipboard
commands.description: Reads the clipboard: copied text, or a copied image such as a business-card photo from your iPhone.

preferences.name: defaultCountry
preferences.title: Your Country
preferences.description: Adds your country code to phone numbers written without one (0664 … becomes +43 664 …), so your iPhone matches incoming calls. Off by default.

preferences.name: debugLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Include contact details in the debug log
preferences.description: Steps, timings and errors are always logged to ~/Library/Logs/SaveVCards.log. Turn this on to also log names, emails and accounts while troubleshooting.
